Hi team! I wanted to share that the shared project calendar is available for colleagues to use. It gives us a common place to look at upcoming work, and I hope it can be a helpful starting point for conversations about how we coordinate.

When you have a chance to take a look, I would appreciate your feedback. I am especially interested in understanding what you need from a shared view of upcoming work and whether the calendar gives you a useful place to find that information. Different people may approach the same work from different perspectives, so hearing from everyone can help make those needs clearer.

Please feel free to share your thoughts here. It is fine to mention anything that feels useful, anything that is unclear, or any needs you would like us to consider as we talk about the calendar together.

Thanks for taking the time to look and for sharing your perspective. I am looking forward to hearing what would make this shared resource useful for the team.
